events.title: Iran war / Hormuz and Red Sea disruption lifts Brent to ~$95 (peak ~$110 on 16 Oct)
events.description: US/Israel-Iran war with repeated tanker attacks in Hormuz, Houthi attacks on Saudi targets/East-West pipeline, Saudi output reported at lowest since 1990 (Bloomberg headline, 10 Sep). Brent touched $110 on 16 Oct, settled at 6-month highs 30 Oct, then fell ~16% in the week to 5 Nov on US-Iran talk hopes (Islamabad rounds; ceasefire described as 'on life support' on 3 Nov). Indian crude basket traded well above Brent futures (basket $122 vs $106 Brent per Gujarat Samachar headline 14 Oct) as physical premia/freight spiked. India's April-Sept crude import bill +46% to $90.6bn (ThePrint/Moneycontrol, 19-21 Oct).

Refining-margin proxy +15.4% since 1 Jun, +72.7% y/y. USD/INR 94.49 (+6.5% y/y). Gold -8.4% and silver -30% since 1 Jun.

events.title: Retail petrol/diesel price freeze with crude >$100 squeezes OMC marketing margins; Q2 FY27 results split refiners
events.description: Retail petrol/diesel prices unchanged while crude surged: ICRA/Express/TOI estimated OMC losses of ~Rs530 crore/day (23-24 Sep) and up to Rs30/litre on some sales (TOI 16 Oct); petrol margins briefly turned positive in early Oct (ET 7 Oct) then reversed with Brent $100-110. Private retailers Jio-bp and Nayara raised prices (Jio-bp +Rs5 petrol/+Rs3 diesel, 11 Oct) and capped diesel sales (ET 28 Sep). Q2 FY27 PAT headlines: IOC Rs21,630 cr (swing from Q1 loss; record, helped by LPG compensation and refining margins), HPCL Rs3,625 cr (-6% y/y; another headline says Rs3,483 cr), BPCL Rs4,993 cr (-22.5%, 'fuel price freeze'). Oil PSUs total Rs30,106 cr = 39% of FY26 profit in one quarter (FE 1 Nov). IOC/PSU GRM $/bbl and per-litre marketing margins NOT verified from filings; indicative numbers above are headline-level.

events.title: India coal crunch: critical plant stocks, e-auction premiums ~94%, captive plants ordered to maximise output; CIL October output +19%
events.description: Early Sept 61 thermal plants at critical stocks (PSU Watch 8 Sep); by 21 Sep 74 plants had <=7 days (CEA/Business Standard); over half critical on 21 Oct (TOI). Government invoked emergency powers (captive plants to run full capacity, 26-28 Sep; Sec 11 for imported-coal plants such as Mundra extended to 31 Dec). A mandatory imported-coal blending plan was weighed (Reuters 25 Sep) then shelved (23 Oct). E-auction premiums reached ~94% (domain-b 12 Oct). Coal India October output +19.3% to 67.2 Mt, offtake +~19% (BS/CNBC 1-2 Nov); CIL allocated 118 lakh t in October e-auctions; CIL Q2 PAT -31.6% y/y as costs rose and shares fell ~4% on results, then +5% on October volumes. Rail loading 465 rakes/day (The Hindu 9 Oct).
events.what_already_moved: Seaborne thermal coal flat (96, 0% since 1 Jun). COALINDIA +~5% on 2 Nov.

entry_shocks.note: e-auction premium to notified price up to ~94%; notified price unchanged
